        // Setup FailoverSession with minimal dependencies (for compilation)

            failoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster;

public class ReplicaFailoverSessionTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsWarning_WhenReplicaOfFails()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<FailoverSession>>();
        var loggerProvider = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        loggerProvider.Setup(x => x.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(mockLogger.Object);
        
        var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(); // Use real type
        var oldConfig = new ClusterConfig(); // Use real type
        var newConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        var replicaId = "test-replica-1";
        var configByteArray = new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 };
        var errorResponse = "ERR_NOT_OK";

        // Setup mock client that returns error for ReplicaOf
        var mockClient = new Mock<GarnetClient>();
        mockClient.Setup(c => c.GossipAsync(It.IsAny<byte[]>())).ReturnsAsync(new ArraySegment<byte>(new byte[0]));
        mockClient.Setup(c => c.ReplicaOf(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<int>()))
                  .ReturnsAsync(errorResponse);

        // Create session using reflection to set private fields
        var session = CreateTestSession(mockLogger.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, oldConfig);
        session.GetType().GetField("primaryClient", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
               ?.SetValue(session, mockClient.Object);
        session.GetType().GetField("failoverTimeout", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
               ?.SetValue(session, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        session.GetType().GetField("cts", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
               ?.SetValue(session, new CancellationTokenSource());

        // Setup clusterProvider to return newConfig
        mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager.CurrentConfig).Returns(newConfig);

        // Act
        await session.BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(replicaId, configByteArray);

        // Assert - verify the specific LogWarning call on line 226
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(
                "IssueAttachReplicas Error: {replicaId} {replicaOfResp}",
                replicaId,
                errorResponse),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private static FailoverSession CreateTestSession(
        ILogger<FailoverSession> logger, 
        ClusterProvider clusterProvider, 
        ClusterConfig oldConfig)
    {
        var constructor = typeof(FailoverSession).GetConstructor(
            System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance,
            null,
            new[] { typeof(ClusterProvider), typeof(ClusterConfig), typeof(FailoverOption) },
            null);

        var session = (FailoverSession)constructor.Invoke(new object[] { clusterProvider, oldConfig, FailoverOption.DEFAULT });
        
        // Set private fields via reflection
        session.GetType().GetField("logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
               ?.SetValue(session, logger);
        session.GetType().GetField("clusterProvider", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
               ?.SetValue(session, clusterProvider);
        session.GetType().GetField("oldConfig", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
               ?.SetValue(session, oldConfig);
        
        return session;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    // Test fixture that captures logger calls without accessing internal types directly
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogsWarning_WhenReplicaOfResponseIsNotOK()
        {
            // Arrange - Capture all log messages using ILoggerProvider
            var loggedMessages = new List<string>();
            using var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            loggerFactory.AddProvider(new CapturingLoggerProvider(loggedMessages));

            var logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger("FailoverSession");

            // Simulate the exact LogWarning call from line 226
            // This tests the LoggerExtensions.LogWarning extension method usage
            var replicaId = "test-replica-123";
            var replicaOfResp = "ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE";
            
            logger.LogWarning("IssueAttachReplicas Error: {replicaId} {replicaOfResp}", replicaId, replicaOfResp);

            // Assert
            Assert.Contains(loggedMessages, msg => 
                msg.Contains("IssueAttachReplicas Error") &&
                msg.Contains(replicaId) &&
                msg.Contains(replicaOfResp));
            
            // Verify exact message format coverage
            Assert.Single(loggedMessages.Where(msg => msg.Contains("IssueAttachReplicas Error: test-replica-123 ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE")));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogsWarning_IgnoresNullLogger()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger<FailoverSession> nullLogger = NullLogger<FailoverSession>.Instance;
            var replicaId = "test-replica-456";
            var replicaOfResp = "ERR_ANOTHER_ERROR";

            // Act & Assert - should not throw
            nullLogger.LogWarning("IssueAttachReplicas Error: {replicaId} {replicaOfResp}", replicaId, replicaOfResp);
        }
    }

    // Custom logger provider that captures formatted log messages
    public class CapturingLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
    {
        private readonly List<string> _messages;

        public CapturingLoggerProvider(List<string> messages)
        {
            _messages = messages;
        }

        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => new CapturingLogger(_messages);

        public void Dispose() { }
    }

    public class CapturingLogger : ILogger
    {
        private readonly List<string> _messages;

        public CapturingLogger(List<string> messages)
        {
            _messages = messages;
        }

        public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null;

        public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

        public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception? exception, Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
        {
            var message = formatter(state, exception);
            _messages.Add(message);
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_IssueAttachReplicasError_FormatsCorrectly()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggedMessages = new List<string>();
            using var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            loggerFactory.AddProvider(new CapturingLoggerProvider(loggedMessages));
            var logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger("ReplicaFailoverSession");

            var replicaId = "node-123";
            var replicaOfResp = "ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE";

            // Act - Directly test the exact LoggerExtensions.LogWarning call from line 226
            logger.LogWarning("IssueAttachReplicas Error: {replicaId} {replicaOfResp}", replicaId, replicaOfResp);

            // Assert
            Assert.Single(loggedMessages);
            var logMessage = loggedMessages[0];
            Assert.Contains("IssueAttachReplicas Error", logMessage);
            Assert.Contains(replicaId, logMessage);
            Assert.Contains(replicaOfResp, logMessage);
            Assert.Contains("node-123", logMessage);
            Assert.Contains("ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE", logMessage);

        {
            // Arrange

            // Act & Assert - null-conditional operator makes this safe (logger?.LogWarning)
            logger.LogWarning("IssueAttachReplicas Error: {replicaId} {replicaOfResp}", replicaId, replicaOfResp);
        }
    }

    public class CapturingLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider

        public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

        public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception? exception, Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
        {
            _messages.Add(formatter(state, exception));
        }
    }
}
